name: todex-container-pairing-e2e
description: Pairs with a running container like TodeX Desktop does, using TodeX_protocol's pairing code.

scripts.build: tsc --ignoreConfig ${TODEX_PROTOCOL_DIR:-../../../TodeX_protocol}/src/*.ts --outDir dist/protocol --module commonjs --target es2022 --moduleResolution node --ignoreDeprecations 6.0 --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --strict && cp protocol-package.json dist/protocol/package.json
